inventory_rationale: State 6 freezes the accepted module operations, the callable symbols required by deterministic http_router_backend/v1, and every concrete local adapter method required to implement an interface-typed runtime dependency. This includes the access-control backend, PostgreSQL repositories, bounded HTTPS transports, offline administration and composition operations, app factory, credential extractor, principal resolver, and one canonical handler for each externally exposed State 5 operation. No additional implementation-private helpers are invented for coverage; reopen this plan only when later accepted evidence requires another stable callable seam.
